main_body: sci-fi metal wall face with horizontal trim, rivets, pipes and vent
top_band: light blue-grey cap and upper frieze with orange trim band (rows 0-6)
evidence: This is a terrain wall face strip, matching the structure of the reference wall strips (rows 0-31). It has a top cap/frieze band (rows 0-6) with a bright orange edge and dark underside at rows 5-6, followed by recessed vertical panels (rows 7-20) and a stepped lower Wainscot/baseboard section (rows 21-31).

style.evidence: The candidate wall is dominated by large, completely flat solid-colour fills on the blue-grey metal panels (e.g. rows 7-20 and 23-27 have vast stretches of a single flat pixel tone with only 4 corner rivet dots). Compared to the Beodeul wall references which have rich plaster speckle, wood grain, and per-stone shading, the candidate lacks surface texture, weathering, or tonal variation and has much lower information density.
